title: V-CAGE: Vision-Closed-Loop Agentic Generation Engine for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Scaling Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models requires massive datasets that are both semantically coherent and physically feasible. However, existing scene generation methods often lack context-awareness, making it difficult to synthesize high-fidelity environments embedded with rich semantic information, frequently resulting in unreachable target positions that cause tasks to fail prematurely. We present V-CAGE (Vision-Closed-loop Agentic Generation Engine), an agentic framework for autonomous robotic data synthesis. Unlike traditional scripted pipelines, V-CAGE operates as an embodied agentic system, leveraging foundation models to bridge high-level semantic reasoning with low-level physical interaction. Specifically, we introduce Inpainting-Guided Scene Construction to systematically arrange context-aware layouts, ensuring that the generated scenes are both semantically structured and kinematically reachable. To ensure trajectory correctness, we integrate functional metadata with a Vision-Language Model based closed-loop verification mechanism, acting as a visual critic to rigorously filter out silent failures and sever the error propagation chain. Finally, to overcome the storage bottleneck of massive video datasets, we implement a perceptually-driven compression algorithm that achieves over 90\% filesize reduction without compromising downstream VLA training efficacy. By centralizing semantic layout planning and visual self-verification, V-CAGE automates the end-to-end pipeline, enabling the highly scalable synthesis of diverse, high-quality robotic manipulation datasets.
tldr: Proposes V-CAGE, an agentic framework for generating large-scale, high-quality vision-language-action datasets for robotic manipulation, featuring automated scene construction, closed-loop verification, and data compression.
tldr_zh: 提出了V-CAGE，一个用于大规模生成高质量机器人操作VLA数据集的代理框架，具备自动化场景构建、闭环验证和数据压缩功能。
summary_zh: 扩展视觉-语言-动作模型需要大量语义连贯且物理可行的数据集。然而，现有的场景生成方法往往缺乏上下文感知能力，难以合成蕴含丰富语义信息的高保真环境，并常因目标位置无法到达而导致任务提前失败。本文提出V-CAGE（视觉闭环自主生成引擎），一种用于自主机器人数据合成的智能体框架。与传统脚本化流程不同，V-CAGE作为一个具身智能体系统运行，利用基础模型连接高层语义推理与底层物理交互。具体而言，我们引入修复引导的场景构建方法，系统化地安排上下文感知的布局，确保生成场景兼具语义结构性与运动可达性。为保证轨迹正确性，我们将功能元数据与基于视觉-语言模型的闭环验证机制相结合，通过视觉评判器严格过滤静默故障并阻断错误传播链。最后，为克服大规模视频数据集的存储瓶颈，我们实现了感知驱动的压缩算法，在保持下游视觉-语言-动作模型训练效果的同时实现超过90%的文件体积压缩。通过整合语义布局规划与视觉自验证机制，V-CAGE实现了端到端流程自动化，能够可扩展地合成多样化、高质量的机器人操作数据集。

title: SafeMind: A Risk-Aware Differentiable Control Framework for Adaptive and Safe Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Learning-based quadruped controllers achieve impressive agility but typically lack formal safety guarantees under model uncertainty, perception noise, and unstructured contact conditions. We introduce SafeMind, a differentiable stochastic safety-control framework that unifies probabilistic Control Barrier Functions with semantic context understanding and meta-adaptive risk calibration. SafeMind explicitly models epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty through a variance-aware barrier constraint embedded in a differentiable quadratic program, thereby preserving gradient flow for end-to-end training. A semantics-to-constraint encoder modulates safety margins using perceptual or language cues, while a meta-adaptive learner continuously adjusts risk sensitivity across environments. We provide theoretical conditions for probabilistic forward invariance, feasibility, and stability under stochastic dynamics. SafeMind is deployed on Unitree A1 and ANYmal C at 200~Hz and validated across 12 terrain types, dynamic obstacles, morphology perturbations, and semantically defined tasks. Experiments show that SafeMind reduces safety violations by 3--10x and energy consumption by 10--15% relative to state-of-the-art CBF, MPC, and hybrid RL baselines, while maintaining real-time control performance.
tldr: SafeMind is a risk-aware differentiable control framework for quadruped locomotion that integrates stochastic Control Barrier Functions with semantic context understanding and meta-adaptive risk calibration, providing formal safety guarantees and real-time performance on physical robots.
tldr_zh: SafeMind是一个用于四足机器人步态的风险感知可微分控制框架，它将随机控制屏障函数与语义上下文理解及元自适应风险校准相统一，在物理机器人上实现了形式化的安全保证和实时控制性能。
summary_zh: 基于学习的四足机器人控制器展现出令人瞩目的敏捷性，但在模型不确定性、感知噪声及非结构化接触条件下通常缺乏形式化的安全保障。我们提出SafeMind——一种可微分随机安全控制框架，它将概率控制屏障函数与语义情境理解及元自适应风险校准相融合。该框架通过嵌入可微分二次规划的方差感知屏障约束，显式建模认知不确定性和偶然不确定性，从而保持端到端训练的梯度流。语义-约束编码器利用感知或语言线索调节安全裕度，而元自适应学习器则持续调整跨环境风险敏感度。我们为随机动力学下的概率前向不变性、可行性和稳定性提供了理论条件。SafeMind以200Hz频率部署于Unitree A1和ANYmal C机器人，并在12种地形类型、动态障碍物、形态扰动及语义定义任务中完成验证。实验表明，相较于最先进的CBF、MPC及混合强化学习基线方法，SafeMind将安全违规事件减少3至10倍，能耗降低10%至15%，同时保持实时控制性能。

title: Adaptor: Advancing Assistive Teleoperation with Few-Shot Learning and Cross-Operator Generalization
summary: Assistive teleoperation enhances efficiency via shared control, yet inter-operator variability, stemming from diverse habits and expertise, induces highly heterogeneous trajectory distributions that undermine intent recognition stability. We present Adaptor, a few-shot framework for robust cross-operator intent recognition. The Adaptor bridges the domain gap through two stages: (i) preprocessing, which models intent uncertainty by synthesizing trajectory perturbations via noise injection and performs geometry-aware keyframe extraction; and (ii) policy learning, which encodes the processed trajectories with an Intention Expert and fuses them with the pre-trained vision-language model context to condition an Action Expert for action generation. Experiments on real-world and simulated benchmarks demonstrate that Adaptor achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rates and efficiency over baselines. Moreover, the method exhibits low variance across operators with varying expertise, demonstrating robust cross-operator generalization.
tldr: Adaptor is a few-shot learning framework that improves cross-operator generalization for assistive teleoperation by modeling intent uncertainty and fusing trajectory data with a pre-trained vision-language model for action generation.
tldr_zh: Adaptor 是一个少样本学习框架，通过建模意图不确定性并将轨迹数据与预训练的视觉-语言模型融合以生成动作，从而提升了辅助遥操作的跨操作者泛化能力。
summary_zh: 辅助遥操作通过共享控制提升了效率，但操作者因习惯与专业水平的差异会产生高度异构的轨迹分布，这削弱了意图识别的稳定性。我们提出Adaptor——一个用于鲁棒跨操作者意图识别的少样本框架。该框架通过两个阶段弥合领域差异：（一）预处理阶段，通过噪声注入合成轨迹扰动以建模意图不确定性，并执行几何感知的关键帧提取；（二）策略学习阶段，使用意图专家对处理后的轨迹进行编码，并将其与预训练视觉-语言模型上下文融合，以条件化行动专家生成动作。在真实场景与模拟基准上的实验表明，Adaptor实现了最先进的性能，在成功率与效率上均优于基线方法。此外，该方法在不同经验水平的操作者间表现出较低的方差，证明了其强大的跨操作者泛化能力。

title: VAG: Dual-Stream Video-Action Generation for Embodied Data Synthesis
summary: Recent advances in robot foundation models trained on large-scale human teleoperation data have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex real-world tasks. However, scaling these systems remains difficult because collecting task-specific demonstrations is expensive and labor-intensive. Synthetic data, especially generated videos, offer a promising direction, but existing World Models (WMs) are not directly suitable for policy learning since they do not provide paired action trajectories. World-Action (WA) models partially address this by predicting actions with visual outputs, yet often lack strong video-action alignment, while two-stage pipelines that generate video first and then infer actions introduce inefficiency and error accumulation. To address these limitations, we propose VAG, a unified flow-matching-based dual-stream framework that jointly generates video and action under visual and language conditioning. By synchronizing denoising in both branches and using an adaptive 3D pooling mechanism to transfer compact global video context to the action branch, VAG improves cross-modal consistency during generation. Across both simulated and real-world settings, VAG produces aligned video-action pairs with competitive prediction quality, supports executable trajectory replay, and provides useful synthetic pretraining data that improves downstream policy generalization, indicating its potential as a practical world-action model for embodied data synthesis.
tldr: This paper proposes VAG, a dual-stream flow-matching framework that jointly generates synthetic video and action trajectories for robots, conditioned on language, to improve the data efficiency of policy learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VAG，一个基于流匹配的双流框架，用于在语言条件下联合生成机器人视频和动作轨迹，以提升策略学习的数据效率。
summary_zh: 近年来，基于大规模人类远程操作数据训练的机器人基础模型取得了显著进展，使得机器人能够执行日益复杂的现实世界任务。然而，扩展这些系统仍面临挑战，因为收集特定任务演示数据成本高昂且劳动密集。合成数据，尤其是生成视频，为解决这一问题提供了可行方向，但现有的世界模型（WMs）无法直接用于策略学习，因其未提供配对的动作轨迹。世界-动作（WA）模型通过结合视觉输出预测动作在一定程度上缓解了这一问题，但常缺乏视频与动作间的强对齐；而先生成视频再推断动作的两阶段流程则存在效率低下与误差累积的缺陷。针对这些局限性，我们提出VAG——一种基于统一流匹配的双流框架，可在视觉与语言条件约束下联合生成视频与动作。通过同步双分支的去噪过程，并采用自适应三维池化机制将紧凑的全局视频上下文传递至动作分支，VAG在生成过程中提升了跨模态一致性。在模拟与真实场景的实验中，VAG生成的视频-动作对具有良好对齐性及优异的预测质量，支持可执行轨迹回放，并能提供有助于提升下游策略泛化能力的合成预训练数据，这标志着其有望成为具身数据合成中实用的世界-动作模型。

title: Robust Adaptive Backstepping Impedance Control of Robots in Unknown Environments
summary: This paper presents a Robust Adaptive Backstepping Impedance Control (RABIC) strategy for robots operating in contact-rich and uncertain environments. The proposed control strategy considers the complete coupled dynamics of the system and explicitly accounts for key sources of uncertainty, including external disturbances and unmodeled dynamics, while not requiring the robot's dynamic parameters in implementation. We propose a backstepping-based adaptive impedance control scheme for the inner loop to track the reference impedance model. To handle uncertainties, we employ a Taylor series-based estimator for system dynamics and an adaptive estimator for determining the upper bound of external forces. Stability analysis demonstrates the semi-global practical finite-time stability of the overall system. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, a simulated mobile manipulator scenario and experimental evaluations on a real Franka Emika Panda robot were conducted. The proposed approach exhibits safer performance compared to PD control while ensuring trajectory tracking and force monitoring. Overall, the RABIC framework provides a solid basis for future research on adaptive and learning-based impedance control for coupled mobile and fixed serially linked manipulators.
tldr: Proposes a robust adaptive impedance control scheme for robot manipulators in uncertain environments, validated in simulation and on a real Panda robot, focusing on safety and force interaction.
tldr_zh: 为机器人在不确定环境中操作提出了一种鲁棒自适应阻抗控制策略，在仿真和真实Panda机器人上进行了验证，重点关注安全性和力交互。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于富接触和不确定环境中作业机器人的鲁棒自适应反步阻抗控制策略。该控制策略完整考虑了系统的耦合动力学特性，明确处理了外部干扰和未建模动态等关键不确定性来源，且无需在实施中获取机器人的动态参数。针对内环控制，我们设计了基于反步法的自适应阻抗控制方案以跟踪参考阻抗模型。为处理系统不确定性，我们采用基于泰勒级数的系统动力学估计器，并利用自适应估计器确定外力的上限边界。稳定性分析证明了整个系统具有半全局实际有限时间稳定性。为验证所提方法的有效性，研究通过移动机械臂仿真场景和Franka Emika Panda真实机器人实验进行评估。与传统PD控制相比，所提方法在确保轨迹跟踪和力监控的同时展现出更安全的性能。总体而言，该鲁棒自适应反步阻抗控制框架为移动式与固定式串联机械臂耦合系统的自适应及基于学习的阻抗控制研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: A Benchmark of Dexterity for Anthropomorphic Robotic Hands
summary: Dexterity is a central yet ambiguously defined concept in the design and evaluation of anthropomorphic robotic hands. In practice, the term is often used inconsistently, with different systems evaluated under disparate criteria, making meaningful comparisons across designs difficult. This highlights the need for a unified, performance-based definition of dexterity grounded in measurable outcomes rather than proxy metrics. In this work, we introduce POMDAR, a comprehensive dexterity benchmark that formalizes dexterity as task performance across a structured set of manipulation and grasping motions. The benchmark was systematically derived from established taxonomies in human motor control. It is implemented in both real-world and simulation and includes four manipulation configurations: vertical and horizontal configurations, continuous rotation, and pure grasping. The task designs contain mechanical scaffolding to constrain task motion, suppress compensatory strategies, and enable metrics to be measured unambiguously. We define a quantitative scoring metric combining task correctness and execution speed, effectively measuring dexterity as throughput. This enables objective, reproducible, and interpretable evaluation across different hand designs. POMDAR provides an open-source, standardized, and taxonomy-grounded benchmark for consistent comparison and evaluation of anthropomorphic robot hands to facilitate a systematic advancement of dexterous manipulation platforms. CAD, simulation files, and evaluation videos are publicly available at https://srl-ethz.github.io/POMDAR/.
tldr: Introduces POMDAR, a unified performance-based benchmark for dexterity in anthropomorphic robotic hands, implemented in both simulation and reality to enable standardized comparison and evaluation of hand designs.
tldr_zh: 提出POMDAR，一个面向拟人化机器人手灵巧性的统一、基于性能的基准测试，在仿真和现实中均实现，用于标准化地比较和评估不同手的设计。
summary_zh: 灵巧性是人形机器人手设计与评估中的一个核心但定义模糊的概念。在实践中，该术语的使用往往不一致，不同系统在不同的标准下进行评估，使得跨设计的有意义比较变得困难。这凸显了需要一个基于可测量结果、而非替代指标的统一、以性能为本的灵巧性定义。本研究中，我们提出了POMDAR，一个全面的灵巧性基准测试，它将灵巧性形式化为在一系列结构化操作与抓取动作中的任务表现。该基准测试系统地源于人类运动控制领域已有的分类学，并在真实世界和仿真中实现，包含四种操作配置：垂直和水平配置、连续旋转以及纯抓取。任务设计包含了机械框架，以约束任务动作、抑制补偿策略，并确保度量标准能够被明确测量。我们定义了一个结合任务正确性和执行速度的定量评分指标，有效地将灵巧性衡量为吞吐量。这使得不同手部设计能够进行客观、可重复和可解释的评估。POMDAR提供了一个开源、标准化且基于分类学的基准，用于人形机器人手的一致比较与评估，以促进灵巧操作平台系统的进步。CAD文件、仿真文件及评估视频已在https://srl-ethz.github.io/POMDAR/公开提供。

title: Physically Grounded 3D Generative Reconstruction under Hand Occlusion using Proprioception and Multi-Contact Touch
summary: We propose a multimodal, physically grounded approach for metric-scale amodal object reconstruction and pose estimation under severe hand occlusion. Unlike prior occlusion-aware 3D generation methods that rely only on vision, we leverage physical interaction signals: proprioception provides the posed hand geometry, and multi-contact touch constrains where the object surface must lie, reducing ambiguity in occluded regions. We represent object structure as a pose-aware, camera-aligned signed distance field (SDF) and learn a compact latent space with a Structure-VAE. In this latent space, we train a conditional flow-matching diffusion model, pretraining on vision-only images and finetuning on occluded manipulation scenes while conditioning on visible RGB evidence, occluder/visibility masks, the hand latent representation, and tactile information. Crucially, we incorporate physics-based objectives and differentiable decoder-guidance during finetuning and inference to reduce hand--object interpenetration and to align the reconstructed surface with contact observations. Because our method produces a metric, physically consistent structure estimate, it integrates naturally into existing two-stage reconstruction pipelines, where a downstream module refines geometry and predicts appearance. Experiments in simulation show that adding proprioception and touch substantially improves completion under occlusion and yields physically plausible reconstructions at correct real-world scale compared to vision-only baselines; we further validate transfer by deploying the model on a real humanoid robot with an end-effector different from those used during training.
tldr: A method for 3D object reconstruction under hand occlusion using vision, hand proprioception, and multi-contact touch signals to learn a physically plausible object representation, validated in simulation and on a real humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: 一种在手部遮挡下进行3D物体重建的方法，利用视觉、手部本体感觉和多点触觉信号来学习物理上合理的物体表示，并在仿真和真实人形机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种多模态、物理约束的方法，用于在严重手部遮挡条件下实现公制度量级的无模态物体重建与姿态估计。与以往仅依赖视觉的遮挡感知三维生成方法不同，我们利用物理交互信号：本体感知提供带姿态的手部几何信息，多点触觉信号约束物体表面必须处于的位置，从而降低遮挡区域的模糊性。我们将物体结构表示为姿态感知、相机对齐的有符号距离场（SDF），并通过结构变分自编码器学习紧凑的潜在空间。在此潜在空间中，我们训练了一个条件流匹配扩散模型，先基于纯视觉图像进行预训练，再在遮挡操作场景中进行微调，同时以可见RGB信息、遮挡物/可见性掩码、手部潜在表征及触觉信息为条件。关键的是，我们在微调和推理过程中引入了基于物理的约束目标与可微解码器引导机制，以减少手-物体间的相互穿透，并使重建表面与触觉观测对齐。由于本方法生成具有公制度量、物理一致性的结构估计结果，可自然融入现有两阶段重建流程：下游模块进一步优化几何结构并预测外观。仿真实验表明，相较于纯视觉基线方法，加入本体感知与触觉信息能显著提升遮挡条件下的补全效果，并生成符合真实世界尺度、物理合理的重建结果；我们通过将模型部署于训练时未使用过的末端执行器人形机器人上，进一步验证了方法的迁移能力。

title: AssemLM: Spatial Reasoning Multimodal Large Language Models for Robotic Assembly
summary: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, especially for fine-grained manipulation tasks such as robotic assembly. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit preliminary spatial awareness, they largely rely on coarse 2D perception and lack the ability to perform accurate reasoning over 3D geometry, which is crucial for precise assembly operations. To address this limitation, we propose AssemLM, a spatial multimodal large language model tailored for robotic assembly. AssemLM integrates assembly manuals, point clouds, and textual instructions to reason about and predict task-critical 6D assembly poses, enabling explicit geometric understanding throughout the assembly process. To effectively bridge raw 3D perception and high-level reasoning, we adopt a specialized point cloud encoder to capture fine-grained geometric and rotational features, which are then integrated into the multimodal language model to support accurate 3D spatial reasoning for assembly tasks. In addition, we construct AssemBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for assembly-oriented spatial reasoning, comprising over 900K multimodal samples with precise 6D pose annotations. AssemBench extends spatial reasoning evaluation beyond 2D and grounding tasks into full 3D geometric inference, filling a critical gap in existing embodied AI benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AssemLM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 6D pose reasoning across diverse assembly scenarios. Furthermore, real-robot evaluations show that our model can support fine-grained and multi-step assembly execution in real-world settings, demonstrating its potential for robotic assembly applications.
tldr: AssemLM is a multimodal large language model for robotic assembly that integrates 3D point clouds and text to reason about 6D assembly poses, evaluated on a new benchmark and deployed on real robots.
tldr_zh: AssemLM是一个用于机器人装配的多模态大语言模型，它整合3D点云和文本进行6D装配姿态推理，并通过新基准测试并在真实机器人上部署验证。
summary_zh: 空间推理是具身智能的一项基础能力，尤其对于机器人装配等精细操作任务至关重要。尽管当前视觉语言模型已展现出初步的空间感知能力，但其主要依赖粗粒度的二维感知，缺乏对三维几何结构进行精确推理的能力，而这正是精密装配操作的关键所在。为突破这一局限，我们提出了面向机器人装配的空间多模态大语言模型AssemLM。该模型集成装配手册、点云与文本指令，通过推理预测任务关键性的六维装配位姿，实现对装配全过程的显式几何理解。为有效连接原始三维感知与高层推理，我们采用专用点云编码器提取细粒度的几何与旋转特征，并将其融入多模态语言模型中，以支撑装配任务所需的精确三维空间推理。此外，我们构建了面向装配空间推理的大规模数据集与评测基准AssemBench，包含超过90万个带精确六维位姿标注的多模态样本。该基准将空间推理评估从二维与实体定位任务拓展至完整的三维几何推理，填补了现有具身人工智能评测体系的空白。大量实验表明，AssemLM在多种装配场景的六维位姿推理任务中达到了最优性能。实际机器人验证进一步证明，该模型能够支持真实环境下的精细化多步骤装配执行，展现出其在机器人装配应用中的巨大潜力。

title: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches
summary: Accurate object geometry estimation is essential for many downstream tasks, including robotic manipulation and physical interaction. Although vision is the dominant modality for shape perception, it becomes unreliable under occlusions or challenging lighting conditions. In such scenarios, tactile sensing provides direct geometric information through physical contact. However, reconstructing global 3D geometry from sparse local touches alone is fundamentally underconstrained. We present TouchAnything, a framework that leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior for 3D reconstruction from sparse tactile measurements. Unlike prior work that trains category-specific reconstruction networks or learns diffusion models directly from tactile data, we transfer the geometric knowledge encoded in pretrained visual diffusion models to the tactile domain. Given sparse contact constraints and a coarse class-level description of the object, we formulate reconstruction as an optimization problem that enforces tactile consistency while guiding solutions toward shapes consistent with the diffusion prior. Our method reconstructs accurate geometries from only a few touches, outperforms existing baselines, and enables open-world 3D reconstruction of previously unseen object instances. Our project page is https://grange007.github.io/touchanything .
tldr: The paper introduces TouchAnything, a framework that uses a pretrained vision diffusion model as a prior to reconstruct 3D object geometry from sparse robot tactile measurements, enhancing robotic manipulation under poor visual conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TouchAnything框架，利用预训练的视觉扩散模型作为先验，从稀疏的机器人触觉测量中重建3D物体几何，以改善在视觉条件不佳情况下的机器人操作。
summary_zh: 准确的物体几何估测对于包括机器人操作与物理交互在内的诸多下游任务至关重要。虽然视觉是形状感知的主导模态，但在遮挡或复杂光照条件下其可靠性会降低。在此类场景中，触觉感知通过物理接触提供直接的几何信息。然而，仅依靠稀疏的局部触觉数据重建全局三维几何在本质上存在约束不足的问题。我们提出TouchAnything框架，该框架利用预训练的大规模二维视觉扩散模型作为语义和几何先验，从稀疏触觉测量中重建三维结构。不同于以往训练特定类别重建网络或直接从触觉数据学习扩散模型的方法，我们将预训练视觉扩散模型中编码的几何知识迁移到触觉领域。在给定稀疏接触约束及物体粗略类别级描述的前提下，我们将重建问题构建为优化问题：在确保触觉一致性的同时，引导解向符合扩散先验的形状收敛。我们的方法仅需少数几次触碰即可重建精确几何结构，其性能优于现有基线，并能实现先前未见物体实例的开放世界三维重建。项目页面详见 https://grange007.github.io/touchanything。

title: One Interface, Many Robots: Unified Real-Time Low-Level Motion Planning for Collaborative Arms
summary: This paper proposes a common interface for real-time low-level motion planning of collaborative robotic arms, aimed at enabling broader applicability and improved portability across heterogeneous hardware platforms. In previous work, we introduced WinGs Operating Studio (WOS), a middleware solution that abstracts diverse robotic components into uniform software resources and provides a broad suite of language-agnostic APIs. This paper specifically focuses on its minimal yet flexible interface for real-time end-effector trajectory control. By employing an n-degree polynomial interpolator in conjunction with a quadratic programming solver, the proposed method generates smooth, continuously differentiable trajectories with precise position, velocity, and acceleration profiles. We validate our approach in three distinct scenarios. First, in an offline demonstration, a collaborative arm accurately draws various geometric shapes on paper. Second, in an interruptible, low-frequency re-planning setting, a robotic manipulator grasps a dynamic object placed on a moving mobile robot. Finally, we conducted a teleoperation experiment in which one robotic arm controlled another to perform a series of dexterous manipulations, confirming the proposed method's reliability, versatility, and ease of use.
tldr: This paper proposes a unified interface for real-time, low-level motion planning of collaborative robotic arms, using polynomial interpolation and quadratic programming to generate smooth trajectories. It demonstrates the method's effectiveness in offline drawing, dynamic grasping, and teleoperation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协作机器人手臂实时低级运动规划的通用接口，通过多项式插值和二次规划生成平滑轨迹，并在离线绘图、动态抓取和遥操作任务中验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协作机械臂实时底层运动规划的通用接口，旨在提升跨异构硬件平台的适用性与可移植性。在先前工作中，我们介绍了WinGs操作系统（WOS）——一种中间件解决方案，该方案将多样化机器人组件抽象为统一的软件资源，并提供了一套广泛的语言无关API。本文重点关注其面向实时末端执行器轨迹控制的最小化且灵活的接口。通过采用n阶多项式插值器结合二次规划求解器，所提方法能够生成具有精确位置、速度及加速度曲线的平滑连续可微分轨迹。我们在三种不同场景中验证了该方法的有效性：首先在离线演示中，协作机械臂在纸上精确绘制了多种几何形状；其次在可中断的低频重规划场景中，机械臂成功抓取放置在移动机器人上的动态物体；最后通过遥操作实验，使一个机械臂控制另一机械臂完成一系列精细操作，证实了所提方法的可靠性、通用性与易用性。

title: Toward Hardware-Agnostic Quadrupedal World Models via Morphology Conditioning
summary: World models promise a paradigm shift in robotics, where an agent learns the underlying physics of its environment once to enable efficient planning and behavior learning. However, current world models are often hardware-locked specialists: a model trained on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot fails catastrophically on a Unitree Go1 due to the mismatch in kinematic and dynamic properties, as the model overfits to specific embodiment constraints rather than capturing the universal locomotion dynamics. Consequently, a slight change in actuator dynamics or limb length necessitates training a new model from scratch. In this work, we take a step towards a framework for training a generalizable Quadrupedal World Model (QWM) that disentangles environmental dynamics from robot morphology. We address the limitations of implicit system identification, where treating static physical properties (like mass or limb length) as latent variables to be inferred from motion history creates an adaptation lag that can compromise zero-shot safety and efficiency. Instead, we explicitly condition the generative dynamics on the robot's engineering specifications. By integrating a physical morphology encoder and a reward normalizer, we enable the model to serve as a neural simulator capable of generalizing across morphologies. This capability unlocks zero-shot control across a range of embodiments. We introduce, for the first time, a world model that enables zero-shot generalization to new morphologies for locomotion. While we carefully study the limitations of our method, QWM operates as a distribution-bounded interpolator within the quadrupedal morphology family rather than a universal physics engine, this work represents a significant step toward morphology-conditioned world models for legged locomotion.
tldr: Proposes a quadrupedal world model conditioned on explicit robot morphology to generalize across different hardware, enabling zero-shot locomotion control and planning without retraining for each new embodiment.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种通过显式机器人形态条件化的四足机器人世界模型，可在不同硬件间实现泛化，无需为每个新形态重新训练，即可实现零样本的运动控制和规划。
summary_zh: 世界模型为机器人技术带来了一种范式转变：智能体通过一次性学习环境的底层物理规律来实现高效规划与行为学习。然而，当前的世界模型往往是硬件绑定的专用模型——在波士顿动力Spot机器人上训练的模型在宇树Go1上会完全失效，原因在于运动学与动力学特性的不匹配，模型过度拟合特定实体约束而未能捕捉普适的运动规律。因此，执行器动力学或肢体长度的微小变化都需从头训练新模型。本研究提出了一种可泛化的四足机器人世界模型（QWM）训练框架，旨在解耦环境动力学与机器人形态。针对隐式系统辨识的局限性（将质量、肢体长度等静态物理属性视为需从运动历史推断的潜变量，会导致适应延迟并危及零样本安全性及效率），我们改为将生成动力学显式地条件化于机器人工程参数。通过整合物理形态编码器与奖励归一化器，使模型成为能够跨形态泛化的神经模拟器。该能力实现了跨多种实体形态的零样本控制。我们首次提出了一种支持运动任务零样本跨形态泛化的世界模型。尽管我们审慎分析了方法的局限性（QWM本质上是四足形态族内的分布边界插值器而非通用物理引擎），这项工作标志着向形态条件化世界模型用于足式机器人的重要进展。

title: Task-Aware Bimanual Affordance Prediction via VLM-Guided Semantic-Geometric Reasoning
summary: Bimanual manipulation requires reasoning about where to interact with an object and which arm should perform each action, a joint affordance localization and arm allocation problem that geometry-only planners cannot resolve without semantic understanding of task intent. Existing approaches either treat affordance prediction as coarse part segmentation or rely on geometric heuristics for arm assignment, failing to jointly reason about task-relevant contact regions and arm allocation. We reframe bimanual manipulation as a joint affordance localization and arm allocation problem and propose a hierarchical framework for task-aware bimanual affordance prediction that leverages a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generalize across object categories and task descriptions without requiring category-specific training. Our approach fuses multi-view RGB-D observations into a consistent 3D scene representation and generates global 6-DoF grasp candidates, which are then spatially and semantically filtered by querying the VLM for task-relevant affordance regions on each object, as well as for arm allocation to the individual objects, thereby ensuring geometric validity while respecting task semantics. We evaluate our method on a dual-arm platform across nine real-world manipulation tasks spanning four categories: parallel manipulation, coordinated stabilization, tool use, and human handover. Our approach achieves consistently higher task success rates than geometric and semantic baselines for task-oriented grasping, demonstrating that explicit semantic reasoning over affordances and arm allocation helps enable reliable bimanual manipulation in unstructured environments.
tldr: A hierarchical VLM-guided framework for joint affordance localization and arm allocation in bimanual manipulation tasks, improving task success rates in real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该研究提出一个分层框架，利用视觉语言模型进行双手机器人操作中的可承受力定位和手臂分配，在真实世界任务中提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 双手操作需要对物体进行交互位置及应由哪只手臂执行每个动作的推理，这是一个需要结合语义任务意图理解的联合可供性定位与手臂分配问题，仅依赖几何规划的解决方案无法独立解决。现有方法要么将可供性预测简化为粗略部件分割，要么依赖几何启发式规则进行手臂分配，未能对任务相关接触区域与手臂分配进行联合推理。我们将双手操作重新定义为联合可供性定位与手臂分配问题，并提出一种层次化任务感知双手可供性预测框架，该框架利用视觉语言模型（VLM）实现跨物体类别与任务描述的泛化，无需针对特定类别进行训练。我们的方法将多视角RGB-D观测数据融合为一致的三维场景表征，并生成全局六自由度抓取候选位姿，随后通过查询VLM对各物体的任务相关可供性区域及针对特定物体的手臂分配进行空间与语义过滤，从而在保证几何有效性的同时兼顾任务语义。我们在双机械臂平台上对四类共九种真实操作任务进行评估，包括：并行操作、协同稳定、工具使用及人机交接。实验结果表明，在面向任务的抓取中，本方法相较于几何基准与语义基准方法均取得更高且更稳定的任务成功率，这证明对可供性及手臂分配的显式语义推理有助于在非结构化环境中实现可靠的双手操作。

title: Generative Simulation for Policy Learning in Physical Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Developing autonomous physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) systems is limited by the scarcity of large-scale training data to learn robust robot behaviors for real-world applications. In this paper, we introduce a zero-shot "text2sim2real" generative simulation framework that automatically synthesizes diverse pHRI scenarios from high-level natural-language prompts. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), our pipeline procedurally generates soft-body human models, scene layouts, and robot motion trajectories for assistive tasks. We utilize this framework to autonomously collect large-scale synthetic demonstration datasets and then train vision-based imitation learning policies operating on segmented point clouds. We evaluate our approach through a user study on two physically assistive tasks: scratching and bathing. Our learned policies successfully achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, attaining success rates exceeding 80% and demonstrating resilience to unscripted human motion. Overall, we introduce the first generative simulation pipeline for pHRI applications, automating simulation environment synthesis, data collection, and policy learning. Additional information may be found on our project website: https://rchi-lab.github.io/gen_phri/
tldr: This paper introduces a 'text2sim2real' generative simulation framework that uses LLMs and VLMs to automatically create diverse physical human-robot interaction scenarios from text prompts, collects synthetic demonstrations, and trains vision-based imitation learning policies for assistive tasks like scratching and bathing, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个'text2sim2real'生成仿真框架，利用LLM和VLM从文本提示自动生成多样化的人机物理交互场景，收集合成演示数据，并训练基于视觉的模仿学习策略，用于抓痒和洗澡等辅助任务，实现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 开发自主的物理人机交互(pHRI)系统一直受限于大规模训练数据的稀缺性，难以学习适用于现实场景的鲁棒机器人行为。本文提出一种零样本的"文本→仿真→现实"生成式仿真框架，能够根据高层自然语言提示自动合成多样化pHRI场景。该框架利用大型语言模型和视觉语言模型，通过程序化生成软体人体模型、场景布局以及辅助任务的机器人运动轨迹。我们运用该框架自主收集大规模合成演示数据集，并训练基于视觉分割点云的模仿学习策略。通过在抓挠和洗浴两项物理辅助任务中开展用户研究，评估了所提方法的有效性。实验表明，学习到的策略成功实现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移，任务成功率超过80%，并能适应未预设的人体动作。总体而言，我们构建了首个面向pHRI应用的生成式仿真流水线，实现了仿真环境合成、数据收集与策略学习的全流程自动化。更多信息请访问项目网站：https://rchi-lab.github.io/gen_phri/

title: Musculoskeletal Motion Imitation for Learning Personalized Exoskeleton Control Policy in Impaired Gait
summary: Designing generalizable control policies for lower-limb exoskeletons remains fundamentally constrained by exhaustive data collection or iterative optimization procedures, which limit accessibility to clinical populations. To address this challenge, we introduce a device-agnostic framework that combines physiologically plausible musculoskeletal simulation with reinforcement learning to enable scalable personalized exoskeleton assistance for both able-bodied and clinical populations. Our control policies not only generate physiologically plausible locomotion dynamics but also capture clinically observed compensatory strategies under targeted muscular deficits, providing a unified computational model of both healthy and pathological gait. Without task-specific tuning, the resulting exoskeleton control policies produce assistive torque profiles at the hip and ankle that align with state-of-the-art profiles validated in human experiments, while consistently reducing metabolic cost across walking speeds. For simulated impaired-gait models, the learned control policies yield asymmetric, deficit-specific exoskeleton assistance that improves both energetic efficiency and bilateral kinematic symmetry without explicit prescription of the target gait pattern. These results demonstrate that physiologically plausible musculoskeletal simulation via reinforcement learning can serve as a scalable foundation for personalized exoskeleton control across both able-bodied and clinical populations, eliminating the need for extensive physical trials.
tldr: The paper introduces a framework using musculoskeletal simulation and reinforcement learning to learn personalized exoskeleton control policies that reduce metabolic cost for both able-bodied and impaired gait, without needing extensive physical trials.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种结合肌肉骨骼仿真和强化学习的框架，用于学习个性化的外骨骼控制策略，该策略能在无需大量物理试验的情况下，为健全和受损步态降低代谢成本。
summary_zh: 为下肢外骨骼设计具有普适性的控制策略，始终受到详尽的实验数据收集或迭代优化流程的根本性制约，这限制了临床应用人群的可及性。为解决这一难题，我们提出一种设备无关的框架，将生理学上可行的肌肉骨骼模拟与强化学习相结合，从而为健全人群和临床人群提供可扩展的个性化外骨骼辅助。我们的控制策略不仅能够生成符合生理规律的步态动力学，还能捕捉到在特定肌肉缺陷下临床观察到的代偿性策略，为健康与病理步态提供了一个统一的计算模型。无需针对特定任务进行调优，由此生成的外骨骼控制策略可在髋关节和踝关节处产生与经人体实验验证的先进辅助扭矩模式相匹配的助力曲线，同时在不同步行速度下持续降低代谢成本。对于模拟的受损步态模型，所学控制策略能够生成非对称、针对特定缺陷的外骨骼辅助方案，从而在未明确指定目标步态模式的情况下，同时提升能量效率和双侧运动对称性。这些结果表明，通过强化学习实现的生理可行肌肉骨骼模拟，能够为跨越健全人群与临床人群的个性化外骨骼控制提供一个可扩展的基础框架，从而省去大量实体试验的需求。

title: Multimodal Anomaly Detection for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Ensuring safety and reliability in human-robot interaction (HRI) requires the timely detection of unexpected events that could lead to system failures or unsafe behaviours. Anomaly detection thus plays a critical role in enabling robots to recognize and respond to deviations from normal operation during collaborative tasks. While reconstruction models have been actively explored in HRI, approaches that operate directly on feature vectors remain largely unexplored. In this work, we propose MADRI, a framework that first transforms video streams into semantically meaningful feature vectors before performing reconstruction-based anomaly detection. Additionally, we augment these visual feature vectors with the robot's internal sensors' readings and a Scene Graph, enabling the model to capture both external anomalies in the visual environment and internal failures within the robot itself. To evaluate our approach, we collected a custom dataset consisting of a simple pick-and-place robotic task under normal and anomalous conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that reconstruction on vision-based feature vectors alone is effective for detecting anomalies, while incorporating other modalities further improves detection performance, highlighting the benefits of multimodal feature reconstruction for robust anomaly detection in human-robot collaboration.
tldr: The paper proposes a multimodal anomaly detection framework for human-robot interaction, transforming video and sensor data into feature vectors for reconstruction-based detection.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于人机交互的多模态异常检测框架，将视频和传感器数据转换为特征向量以进行基于重构的检测。
summary_zh: 确保人机交互（HRI）的安全与可靠性需要及时检测可能导致系统故障或不安全行为的意外事件。因此，异常检测在使机器人能够识别并应对协作任务中偏离正常操作的情况方面发挥着关键作用。尽管重建模型在HRI领域已得到积极探索，但直接在特征向量上运行的方法仍鲜有研究。本文提出MADRI框架，该框架先将视频流转换为语义丰富的特征向量，再执行基于重建的异常检测。此外，我们通过机器人的内部传感器读数与场景图对这些视觉特征向量进行增强，使模型能够同时捕捉视觉环境中的外部异常和机器人本身的内部故障。为评估该方法，我们收集了由正常和异常条件下的简单拾放机器人任务组成的自定义数据集。实验结果表明，仅基于视觉特征向量的重建已能有效检测异常，而融入其他模态信息则可进一步提升检测性能，这突显了多模态特征重建在实现稳健人机协作异常检测中的优势。

title: 2D or 3D: Who Governs Salience in VLA Models? -- Tri-Stage Token Pruning Framework with Modality Salience Awareness
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as the mainstream of embodied intelligence. Recent VLA models have expanded their input modalities from 2D-only to 2D+3D paradigms, forming multi-visual-modal VLA (MVLA) models. Despite achieving improved spatial perception, MVLA faces a greater acceleration demand due to the increased number of input tokens caused by modal expansion. Token pruning is an effective optimization methods tailored to MVLA models. However, existing token pruning schemes are designed for 2D-only VLA models, ignoring 2D/3D modality salience differences. In this paper, we follow the application process of multi-modal data in MVLA models and develop a tri-stage analysis to capture the discrepancy and dynamics of 2D/3D modality salience. Based on these, we propose a corresponding tri-stage token pruning framework for MVLA models to achieve optimal 2D/3D token selection and efficient pruning. Experiments show that our framework achieves up to a 2.55x inference speedup with minimal accuracy loss, while only costing 5.8% overhead. Our Code is coming soon.
tldr: Proposes a tri-stage token pruning framework for multi-visual-modal Vision-Language-Action (MVLA) models, which use both 2D and 3D inputs, to optimize token selection and improve inference speed.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于多视觉模态VLA模型的三阶段token剪枝框架，旨在优化2D/3D token选择并提升推理速度。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型已成为具身智能的主流范式。当前该模型体系已从纯二维输入模式扩展至二维+三维多模态范式，形成了多视觉模态的视觉-语言-行动模型。尽管通过模态拓展提升了空间感知能力，但由此引发的输入令牌数量激增也使模型面临更严峻的加速需求。令牌剪枝是针对此类模型的有效优化手段，然而现有剪枝方案均为纯二维模型设计，忽略了二维/三维模态的显著性差异。本文通过追踪多模态数据在模型中的应用流程，构建三阶段分析框架以捕捉二维/三维模态显著性的动态差异。基于此发现，我们提出面向多视觉模态视觉-语言-行动模型的三阶段令牌剪枝框架，实现最优的二维/三维令牌选择与高效剪枝。实验表明，该框架在精度损失最小化的前提下可实现最高2.55倍的推理加速，仅产生5.8%的额外开销。代码即将开源。

title: TAIHRI: Task-Aware 3D Human Keypoints Localization for Close-Range Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Accurate 3D human keypoints localization is a critical technology enabling robots to achieve natural and safe physical interaction with users. Conventional 3D human keypoints estimation methods primarily focus on the whole-body reconstruction quality relative to the root joint. However, in practical human-robot interaction (HRI) scenarios, robots are more concerned with the precise metric-scale spatial localization of task-relevant body parts under the egocentric camera 3D coordinate. We propose TAIHRI, the first Vision-Language Model (VLM) tailored for close-range HRI perception, capable of understanding users' motion commands and directing the robot's attention to the most task-relevant keypoints. By quantizing 3D keypoints into a finite interaction space, TAIHRI precisely localize the 3D spatial coordinates of critical body parts by 2D keypoint reasoning via next token prediction, and seamlessly adapt to downstream tasks such as natural language control or global space human mesh recovery. Experiments on egocentric interaction benchmarks demonstrate that TAIHRI achieves superior estimation accuracy for task-critical body parts. We believe TAIHRI opens new research avenues in the field of embodied human-robot interaction. Code is available at: https://github.com/Tencent/TAIHRI.
tldr: TAIHRI is a Vision-Language Model designed for close-range Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) that localizes task-relevant 3D human keypoints from an egocentric view, enabling robots to focus on specific body parts based on natural language commands.
tldr_zh: TAIHRI 是一个为近距离人机交互设计的视觉语言模型，它能从第一人称视角定位任务相关的 3D 人体关键点，使机器人能够根据自然语言指令专注于特定的身体部位。
summary_zh: 精准的三维人体关键点定位是实现机器人与用户进行自然、安全物理交互的关键技术。传统的三维人体关键点估计方法主要关注以根关节为基准的整体重建质量。然而，在实际人机交互场景中，机器人更需关注任务相关身体部位在自我中心相机三维坐标系下的精确度量空间定位。我们提出TAIHRI，这是首个专为近距离人机交互感知定制的视觉语言模型，能够理解用户的动作指令，并将机器人注意力引导至任务最相关的关键点。通过将三维关键点量化到有限交互空间，TAIHRI借助下一词预测的二维关键点推理机制，精准定位关键身体部位的三维空间坐标，并可无缝适配自然语言控制或全局空间人体网格重建等下游任务。在自我中心交互基准测试上的实验表明，TAIHRI对任务关键身体部位实现了卓越的估计精度。我们相信TAIHRI为具身人机交互领域开辟了新的研究途径。代码已开源：https://github.com/Tencent/TAIHRI。

title: Online Intention Prediction via Control-Informed Learning
summary: This paper presents an online intention prediction framework for estimating the goal state of autonomous systems in real time, even when intention is time-varying, and system dynamics or objectives include unknown parameters. The problem is formulated as an inverse optimal control / inverse reinforcement learning task, with the intention treated as a parameter in the objective. A shifting horizon strategy discounts outdated information, while online control-informed learning enables efficient gradient computation and online parameter updates. Simulations under varying noise levels and hardware experiments on a quadrotor drone demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves accurate, adaptive intention prediction in complex environments.
tldr: Presents an online, adaptive intention prediction framework using inverse optimal control/reinforcement learning, demonstrated on a quadrotor drone.
tldr_zh: 提出一种在线自适应意图预测框架，利用逆最优控制/强化学习，并在四旋翼无人机上进行了实验验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种在线意图预测框架，用于实时估计自主系统的目标状态，即使面对意图时变、系统动力学或目标函数包含未知参数的情况。该问题被建模为逆最优控制/逆强化学习任务，其中意图被视为目标函数中的参数。通过采用滑动时域策略对过时信息进行衰减处理，并结合在线控制感知学习方法实现高效梯度计算与实时参数更新。在不同噪声水平下的仿真实验及四旋翼无人机硬件测试表明，所提出的方法能够在复杂环境中实现精准、自适应的意图预测。

title: Soft Electroadhesive Feet for Micro Aerial Robots Perching on Smooth and Curved Surfaces
summary: Electroadhesion (EA) provides electrically switchable adhesion and is a promising mechanism for perching micro aerial robots on smooth surfaces. However, practical implementations of soft and stretchable EA pads for aerial perching remain limited. This work presents (i) an efficient workflow for fabricating soft, stretchable electroadhesive pads with sinusoidal wave and concentric-circle electrodes in multiple sizes, (ii) a controlled experimental comparison of normal and shear adhesion under inactive (0 kV) and active (4.8 kV) conditions using an Instron-based setup, and (iii) a perching demonstration using a Crazyflie quadrotor equipped with electroadhesive feet on flat and curved substrates. Experimental results show that shear adhesion dominates, reaching forces on the order of 3 N with partial pad contact, while normal adhesion is comparatively small and strongly dependent on substrate properties. The Crazyflie prototype demonstrates repeatable attachment on smooth plastic surfaces, including curved geometries, as well as rapid detachment when the voltage is removed. These results highlight the potential of soft electroadhesive feet for lightweight and reliable perching in micro aerial vehicles (MAVs).
tldr: This paper presents the design, fabrication, and testing of soft, stretchable electroadhesive feet for micro aerial robots, demonstrating successful perching on smooth and curved surfaces.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了为微型飞行机器人设计、制造和测试的软性可拉伸电粘附脚垫，成功展示了其在光滑和曲面上的可靠栖息能力。
summary_zh: 电粘附技术能提供可电控切换的粘附力，为微型飞行机器人栖息于光滑表面提供了一种前景广阔的技术路径。然而，目前适用于空中栖息的柔性可拉伸电粘附垫在实际应用中仍存在局限。本研究提出：(1) 一种高效制造多尺寸正弦波与同心圆电极柔性可拉伸电粘附垫的工艺流程；(2) 基于英斯特朗测试系统，在无激励（0 kV）与激励（4.8 kV）条件下对法向及剪切粘附力进行受控实验对比；(3) 搭载电粘附足的四旋翼飞行器在平面及曲面基底上的栖息演示实验。结果表明：剪切粘附占主导地位，在电极垫部分接触状态下即可产生约3 N的粘附力，而法向粘附力相对较小且对基底特性高度敏感。搭载电粘附足的四旋翼原型机在光滑塑料表面（包括曲面结构）实现了可重复的附着，并在断电后能快速分离。这些发现彰显了柔性电粘附足在微型飞行器轻量化可靠栖息应用中的潜力。

title: Fine-Grained Action Segmentation for Renorrhaphy in Robot-Assisted Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Fine-grained action segmentation during renorrhaphy in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy requires frame-level recognition of visually similar suturing gestures with variable duration and substantial class imbalance. The SIA-RAPN benchmark defines this problem on 50 clinical videos acquired with the da Vinci Xi system and annotated with 12 frame-level labels. The benchmark compares four temporal models built on I3D features: MS-TCN++, AsFormer, TUT, and DiffAct. Evaluation uses balanced accuracy, edit score, segmental F1 at overlap thresholds of 10, 25, and 50, frame-wise accuracy, and frame-wise mean average precision. In addition to the primary evaluation across five released split configurations on SIA-RAPN, the benchmark reports cross-domain results on a separate single-port RAPN dataset. Across the strongest reported values over those five runs on the primary dataset, DiffAct achieves the highest F1, frame-wise accuracy, edit score, and frame mAP, while MS-TCN++ attains the highest balanced accuracy.
tldr: The paper introduces a benchmark for fine-grained action segmentation of surgical suturing gestures in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy, evaluating several temporal models on clinical robotic surgery videos.
tldr_zh: 本文针对机器人辅助肾部分切除术中的缝合动作，提出了一个细粒度动作分割基准，在临床机器人手术视频上评估了几种时序模型。
summary_zh: 在机器人辅助肾部分切除术的肾实质缝合阶段，精细动作分割需要对视觉相似、持续时间可变且存在显著类别不平衡的缝合手势进行帧级识别。SIA-RAPN基准测试基于达芬奇Xi系统采集的50段临床视频定义了该问题，这些视频已标注12类帧级标签。该基准比较了四种基于I3D特征构建的时间模型：MS-TCN++、AsFormer、TUT和DiffAct。评估指标包括平衡准确率、编辑分数、重叠阈值为10%、25%和50%的分段F1值、帧级准确率及帧级平均精度均值。除在SIA-RAPN五组公开划分配置上进行主要评估外，该基准还报告了在独立单孔RAPN数据集上的跨域结果。在主数据集的五轮实验最优值中，DiffAct在分段F1、帧级准确率、编辑分数和帧级平均精度均值上取得最高成绩，而MS-TCN++则获得了最高的平衡准确率。

title: WOMBET: World Model-based Experience Transfer for Robust and Sample-efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in robotics is often limited by the cost and risk of data collection, motivating experience transfer from a source task to a target task. Offline-to-online RL leverages prior data but typically assumes a given fixed dataset and does not address how to generate reliable data for transfer. We propose \textit{World Model-based Experience Transfer} (WOMBET), a framework that jointly generates and utilizes prior data. WOMBET learns a world model in the source task and generates offline data via uncertainty-penalized planning, followed by filtering trajectories with high return and low epistemic uncertainty. It then performs online fine-tuning in the target task using adaptive sampling between offline and online data, enabling a stable transition from prior-driven initialization to task-specific adaptation. We show that the uncertainty-penalized objective provides a lower bound on the true return and derive a finite-sample error decomposition capturing distribution mismatch and approximation error. Empirically, WOMBET improves sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines on continuous control benchmarks, demonstrating the benefit of jointly optimizing data generation and transfer.
tldr: Proposes a method that learns a world model in a source task to generate high-quality offline data, which is then used to improve sample efficiency and performance in a target RL task via fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种方法，在源任务中学习世界模型以生成高质量离线数据，然后通过微调将该数据用于提升目标任务中强化学习的样本效率和最终性能。
summary_zh: 机器人领域的强化学习常因数据收集成本与风险受限，这促使研究从源任务向目标任务迁移经验的方法。离线转在线强化学习虽能利用先验数据，但通常假设给定固定数据集，且未解决如何生成可靠迁移数据的问题。本文提出一种基于世界模型的迁移经验框架（WOMBET），该框架可协同生成并利用先验数据。WOMBET在源任务中学习世界模型，通过不确定性惩罚规划生成离线数据，继而筛选出高回报、低认知不确定性的轨迹。随后在目标任务中采用离线与在线数据自适应采样的方式进行在线微调，实现从先验驱动初始化到任务自适应学习的平稳过渡。研究表明，不确定性惩罚目标函数为真实回报提供了下界，并通过有限样本误差分解解析了分布不匹配与近似误差的影响。实验证明，在连续控制基准测试中，WOMBET较现有强基线方法显著提升了样本效率与最终性能，验证了协同优化数据生成与迁移策略的有效性。

title: HTNav: A Hybrid Navigation Framework with Tiered Structure for Urban Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Inspired by the general Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) task, aerial VLN has attracted widespread attention, owing to its significant practical value in applications such as logistics delivery and urban inspection. However, existing methods face several challenges in complex urban environments, including insufficient generalization to unseen scenes, suboptimal performance in long-range path planning, and inadequate understanding of spatial continuity. To address these challenges, we propose HTNav, a new collaborative navigation framework that integrates Imitation Learning (IL) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) within a hybrid IL-RL framework. This framework adopts a staged training mechanism to ensure the stability of the basic navigation strategy while enhancing its environmental exploration capability. By integrating a tiered decision-making mechanism, it achieves collaborative interaction between macro-level path planning and fine-grained action control. Furthermore, a map representation learning module is introduced to deepen its understanding of spatial continuity in open domains. On the CityNav benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across all scene levels and task difficulties. Experimental results demonstrate that this framework significantly improves navigation precision and robustness in complex urban environments.
tldr: The paper proposes HTNav, a hybrid IL-RL navigation framework for aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) in urban environments, which integrates a tiered decision-making mechanism and map representation learning to improve long-range path planning and spatial understanding.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于城市空中视觉与语言导航的混合模仿学习与强化学习框架HTNav，它整合了分层决策机制和地图表示学习，以提高长距离路径规划和空间连续性的理解能力。
summary_zh: 受通用视觉语言导航任务的启发，空中视觉语言导航因其在物流配送、城市巡检等应用中的重要实用价值，已引起广泛关注。然而，现有方法在复杂城市环境中面临诸多挑战，包括对未见场景泛化能力不足、长距离路径规划性能欠佳以及对空间连续性的理解不充分。针对这些问题，本文提出HTNav——一种新型协作导航框架，将模仿学习与强化学习整合于混合IL-RL架构中。该框架采用分阶段训练机制，在保证基础导航策略稳定性的同时，增强了对环境的探索能力。通过引入分层决策机制，实现了宏观路径规划与细粒度动作控制的协同交互。此外，引入地图表示学习模块以深化对开放领域空间连续性的理解。在CityNav基准测试中，我们的方法在所有场景层级和任务难度下均取得了最优性能。实验结果表明，该框架显著提升了复杂城市环境中的导航精度与鲁棒性。

title: Advantage-Guided Diffusion for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) with autoregressive world models suffers from compounding errors, whereas diffusion world models mitigate this by generating trajectory segments jointly. However, existing diffusion guides are either policy-only, discarding value information, or reward-based, which becomes myopic when the diffusion horizon is short. We introduce Advantage-Guided Diffusion for MBRL (AGD-MBRL), which steers the reverse diffusion process using the agent's advantage estimates so that sampling concentrates on trajectories expected to yield higher long-term return beyond the generated window. We develop two guides: (i) Sigmoid Advantage Guidance (SAG) and (ii) Exponential Advantage Guidance (EAG). We prove that a diffusion model guided through SAG or EAG allows us to perform reweighted sampling of trajectories with weights increasing in state-action advantage-implying policy improvement under standard assumptions. Additionally, we show that the trajectories generated from AGD-MBRL follow an improved policy (that is, with higher value) compared to an unguided diffusion model. AGD integrates seamlessly with PolyGRAD-style architectures by guiding the state components while leaving action generation policy-conditioned, and requires no change to the diffusion training objective. On MuJoCo control tasks (HalfCheetah, Hopper, Walker2D and Reacher), AGD-MBRL improves sample efficiency and final return over PolyGRAD, an online Diffuser-style reward guide, and model-free baselines (PPO/TRPO), in some cases by a margin of 2x. These results show that advantage-aware guidance is a simple, effective remedy for short-horizon myopia in diffusion-model MBRL.
tldr: This paper proposes Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD-MBRL) for model-based reinforcement learning, which uses advantage estimates to guide the diffusion process for improved long-term planning and sample efficiency on MuJoCo control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出用于基于模型的强化学习的优势引导扩散方法（AGD-MBRL），该方法利用优势估计引导扩散过程，以在MuJoCo控制任务中实现更好的长期规划和样本效率。
summary_zh: 基于自回归世界模型的强化学习（MBRL）面临误差累积问题，而扩散世界模型通过联合生成轨迹片段缓解了这一难题。然而，现有扩散引导方法要么仅依赖策略信息而忽略价值函数，要么基于即时奖励设计，在扩散视野较短时易陷入短视困境。本文提出优势引导的扩散模型强化学习方法（AGD-MBRL），通过智能体的优势估计值引导反向扩散过程，使采样集中于预期能在生成窗口之外获得更高长期回报的轨迹。我们开发了两种引导机制：（1）S型优势引导（SAG）与（2）指数优势引导（EAG）。理论证明表明，经SAG或EAG引导的扩散模型能够实现对轨迹的加权采样，其权重随状态-动作优势值递增——这意味着在标准假设下可实现策略改进。此外，相较于无引导扩散模型，AGD-MBRL生成的轨迹遵循改进策略（即具有更高价值估计）。该方法可无缝集成至PolyGRAD架构：在保持动作生成与策略条件绑定的同时，仅对状态分量进行引导，且无需修改扩散训练目标。在MuJoCo控制任务（HalfCheetah、Hopper、Walker2D和Reacher）中，AGD-MBRL在样本效率与最终回报上均超越PolyGRAD、在线Diffuser式奖励引导方法以及无模型基线（PPO/TRPO），部分任务性能提升达两倍。这些结果表明，优势感知引导是解决扩散模型MBRL中短视问题的简洁高效方案。

title: EgoTL: Egocentric Think-Aloud Chains for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Large foundation models have made significant advances in embodied intelligence, enabling synthesis and reasoning over egocentric input for household tasks. However, VLM-based auto-labeling is often noisy because the primary data sources lack accurate human action labels, chain-of-thought (CoT), and spatial annotations; these errors are amplified during long-horizon spatial instruction following. These issues stem from insufficient coverage of minute-long, daily household planning tasks and from inaccurate spatial grounding. As a result, VLM reasoning chains and world-model synthesis can hallucinate objects, skip steps, or fail to respect real-world physical attributes. To address these gaps, we introduce EgoTL. EgoTL builds a think-aloud capture pipeline for egocentric data. It uses a say-before-act protocol to record step-by-step goals and spoken reasoning with word-level timestamps, then calibrates physical properties with metric-scale spatial estimators, a memory-bank walkthrough for scene context, and clip-level tags for navigation instructions and detailed manipulation actions. With EgoTL, we are able to benchmark VLMs and World Models on six task dimensions from three layers and long-horizon generation over minute-long sequences across over 100 daily household tasks. We find that foundation models still fall short as egocentric assistants or open-world simulators. Finally, we finetune foundation models with human CoT aligned with metric labels on the training split of EgoTL, which improves long-horizon planning and reasoning, step-wise reasoning, instruction following, and spatial grounding.
tldr: EgoTL introduces a think-aloud capture pipeline for egocentric data to create a benchmark for evaluating VLMs and world models on long-horizon household tasks, and shows that finetuning on this data improves planning, reasoning, and spatial grounding.
tldr_zh: EgoTL 引入了一种用于自我中心数据的“出声思考”采集流程，旨在创建一个用于评估视觉语言模型和世界模型在长时程家庭任务上表现的基准，并证明在该数据上微调能提升规划、推理和空间定位能力。
summary_zh: 大型基础模型在具身智能领域取得了显著进展，能够针对日常家庭任务实现以第一人称视角输入的综合分析与推理。然而，基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动标注往往存在噪声，主要原因是原始数据源缺乏精确的人类动作标签、思维链（CoT）及空间标注，这些误差在长时序空间指令跟随任务中会被进一步放大。这些问题源于现有数据对分钟级日常家庭规划任务的覆盖不足，以及空间定位的准确性欠缺。因此，视觉语言模型的推理链与世界模型综合可能产生物体幻觉、跳过关键步骤，或无法符合真实世界的物理属性。为填补这些空白，本研究提出EgoTL框架。EgoTL构建了一套用于第一人称数据的出声思考采集流程，采用"先言后行"协议逐步记录目标节点和带词级时间戳的口语推理，进而通过公制空间估计器校准物理属性、利用记忆库巡览获取场景上下文，并借助片段级标签标定导航指令与精细操作动作。基于EgoTL，我们实现了对视觉语言模型和世界模型在三个层级、六个任务维度上的系统性评估，并对超过100项日常家庭任务中分钟级长时序生成能力进行测试。研究发现，基础模型在作为第一人称助手或开放世界模拟器方面仍存在不足。最后，我们利用EgoTL训练集中与公制标注对齐的人类思维链数据对基础模型进行微调，显著提升了模型在长时序规划推理、分步推理、指令跟随及空间定位方面的性能。

title: Continuous Orthogonal Mode Decomposition: Haptic Signal Prediction in Tactile Internet
summary: The Tactile Internet demands sub-millisecond latency and ultra-high reliability, as high latency or packet loss could lead to haptic control instability. To address this, we propose the Mode-Domain Architecture (MDA), a bilateral predictive neural network architecture designed to restore missing signals on both the human and robot sides. Unlike conventional models that extract features implicitly from raw data, MDA utilizes a novel Continuous-Orthogonal Mode Decomposition framework. By integrating an orthogonality constraint, we overcome the pervasive issue of "mode overlapping" found in state-of-the-art decomposition methods. Experimental results demonstrate that this structured feature extraction achieves high prediction accuracies of 98.6% (human) and 97.3% (robot). Furthermore, the model achieves ultra-low inference latency of 0.065 ms, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks and meeting the stringent real-time requirements of haptic teleoperation.
tldr: Proposes a novel neural network architecture using orthogonal mode decomposition for ultra-low latency, high-accuracy prediction and restoration of haptic signals in bilateral teleoperation, meeting Tactile Internet requirements.
tldr_zh: 提出一种新颖的神经网络架构，利用正交模态分解实现超低延迟、高精度的触觉信号预测与恢复，以满足触觉互联网在双边遥操作中的严格要求。
summary_zh: 触觉互联网要求亚毫秒级延迟和超高可靠性，因为高延迟或数据包丢失可能导致触觉控制失稳。为此，我们提出模式域架构（MDA），这是一种专为恢复人机两端缺失信号而设计的双向预测神经网络架构。与从原始数据中隐式提取特征的传统模型不同，MDA采用了一种新颖的连续正交模式分解框架。通过引入正交性约束，我们解决了现有先进分解方法中普遍存在的“模式混叠”问题。实验结果表明，这种结构化特征提取实现了高达98.6%（人端）和97.3%（机器人端）的预测准确率。此外，该模型实现了0.065毫秒的超低推理延迟，显著优于现有基准模型，满足触觉遥操作严格的实时性要求。

title: Scene-Agnostic Object-Centric Representation Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent works on 3D scene understanding leverage 2D masks from visual foundation models (VFMs) to supervise radiance fields, enabling instance-level 3D segmentation. However, the supervision signals from foundation models are not fundamentally object-centric and often require additional mask pre/post-processing or specialized training and loss design to resolve mask identity conflicts across views. The learned identity of the 3D scene is scene-dependent, limiting generalizability across scenes. Therefore, we propose a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme to learn object representations in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Building on a pre-trained slot attention-based Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) module, we learn a scene-agnostic object codebook that provides consistent, identity-anchored representations across views and scenes. By coupling the codebook with the module's unsupervised object masks, we can directly supervise the identity features of 3D Gaussians without additional mask pre-/post-processing or explicit multi-view alignment. The learned scene-agnostic codebook enables object supervision and identification without per-scene fine-tuning or retraining. Our method thus introduces unsupervised object-centric learning (OCL) into 3DGS, yielding more structured representations and better generalization for downstream tasks such as robotic interaction, scene understanding, and cross-scene generalization.
tldr: Proposes a method to learn scene-agnostic object-centric representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting using a pre-trained object-centric module and a shared codebook, enabling unsupervised instance-level 3D segmentation with applications in robotics.
tldr_zh: 提出一种方法，利用预训练的以物体为中心的模块和共享码本，为3D高斯泼溅学习场景无关的以物体为中心的表示，实现无监督的实例级3D分割，并应用于机器人交互等下游任务。
summary_zh: 近期，在三维场景理解领域的研究工作中，利用视觉基础模型（VFM）提供的二维掩码作为监督信息来指导辐射场的学习，实现了实例级别的三维分割。然而，基础模型提供的监督信号本质并非以对象为中心，通常需要额外的掩码前/后处理或专门的训练与损失设计，以解决多视角间的掩码身份冲突问题。学到的三维场景身份表示与特定场景强相关，限制了其在不同场景间的泛化能力。为此，我们提出一种数据集层面的、以对象为中心的监督机制，用于在三维高斯溅射（3DGS）中学习对象表示。基于一个预训练的基于槽注意力的全局对象中心学习（GOCL）模块，我们学习一个与场景无关的对象码本，它能够提供跨视角和跨场景的一致、身份锚定的表示。通过将码本与模块的无监督对象掩码结合，我们可以直接对三维高斯点的身份特征进行监督，无需额外的掩码前/后处理或显式的多视角对齐。所学习的场景无关码本能够实现对象监督与识别，无需针对每个场景进行微调或重新训练。因此，本方法将无监督的对象中心学习（OCL）引入到3DGS中，从而生成更结构化的表示，并在机器人交互、场景理解以及跨场景泛化等下游任务中展现出更好的泛化性能。

title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Vision agent memory has shown remarkable effectiveness in streaming video understanding. However, storing such memory for videos incurs substantial memory overhead, leading to high costs in both storage and computation. To address this issue, we propose StreamMeCo, an efficient Stream Agent Memory Compression framework. Specifically, based on the connectivity of the memory graph, StreamMeCo introduces edge-free minmax sampling for the isolated nodes and an edge-aware weight pruning for connected nodes, evicting the redundant memory nodes while maintaining the accuracy. In addition, we introduce a time-decay memory retrieval mechanism to further eliminate the performance degradation caused by memory compression. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmark datasets (M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web and Video-MME-Long) demonstrate that under 70% memory graph compression, StreamMeCo achieves a 1.87* speedup in memory retrieval while delivering an average accuracy improvement of 1.0%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo.
tldr: StreamMeCo is a memory compression framework for efficient streaming video understanding, using graph-based sampling and pruning to reduce storage and computation overhead while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: StreamMeCo 是一个用于高效流式视频理解的记忆压缩框架，通过基于图的采样和剪枝来减少存储和计算开销，同时保持准确性。
summary_zh: 视觉代理记忆在流式视频理解中展现出显著成效。然而，为视频存储此类记忆会带来巨大的内存开销，导致存储与计算成本高昂。为解决这一问题，我们提出了StreamMeCo——一种高效的流式代理记忆压缩框架。具体而言，基于记忆图的连通性，StreamMeCo针对孤立节点提出无边界最小最大采样方法，对连通节点则采用边感知权重剪枝策略，在保持准确性的同时剔除冗余记忆节点。此外，我们引入了时间衰减记忆检索机制，以进一步消除因记忆压缩导致的性能下降。在三个具有挑战性的基准数据集（M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web和Video-MME-Long）上的大量实验表明，在70%记忆图压缩率下，StreamMeCo实现了1.87倍的内存检索加速，同时平均准确率提升了1.0%。代码已开源：https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo。

title: AniGen: Unified $S^3$ Fields for Animatable 3D Asset Generation
summary: Animatable 3D assets, defined as geometry equipped with an articulated skeleton and skinning weights, are fundamental to interactive graphics, embodied agents, and animation production. While recent 3D generative models can synthesize visually plausible shapes from images, the results are typically static. Obtaining usable rigs via post-hoc auto-rigging is brittle and often produces skeletons that are topologically inconsistent with the generated geometry. We present AniGen, a unified framework that directly generates animate-ready 3D assets conditioned on a single image. Our key insight is to represent shape, skeleton, and skinning as mutually consistent $S^3$ Fields (Shape, Skeleton, Skin) defined over a shared spatial domain. To enable the robust learning of these fields, we introduce two technical innovations: (i) a confidence-decaying skeleton field that explicitly handles the geometric ambiguity of bone prediction at Voronoi boundaries, and (ii) a dual skin feature field that decouples skinning weights from specific joint counts, allowing a fixed-architecture network to predict rigs of arbitrary complexity. Built upon a two-stage flow-matching pipeline, AniGen first synthesizes a sparse structural scaffold and then generates dense geometry and articulation in a structured latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AniGen substantially outperforms state-of-the-art sequential baselines in rig validity and animation quality, generalizing effectively to in-the-wild images across diverse categories including animals, humanoids, and machinery. Homepage: https://yihua7.github.io/AniGen-web/
tldr: AniGen generates animatable 3D assets with skeletons and skinning weights from a single image, using a unified S^3 fields representation to ensure consistency, and significantly outperforms baselines.
tldr_zh: AniGen 是一个从单张图像直接生成带有骨骼和蒙皮权重的可动画3D资产的框架，通过统一的S^3场表示确保一致性，性能显著优于现有基线。
summary_zh:
摘要：
可动画化三维资产，指配备有关节骨架和蒙皮权重的几何模型，是交互式图形、具身智能体与动画制作的基础。虽然当前的三维生成模型能够从图像中合成视觉上合理的形状，但结果通常为静态。通过事后自动绑定技术获取可用骨架系统存在脆弱性，且往往产生与生成几何在拓扑结构上不一致的骨架。我们提出AniGen——一个统一框架，能够基于单张图像直接生成可用于动画的三维资产。我们的核心思想是将形状、骨架和蒙皮表达为在共享空间域上定义的、彼此协调的$S^3$场（形状场、骨架场、蒙皮场）。为实现对这些场模型的稳健学习，我们引入两项技术创新：（i）采用置信度衰减的骨架场，以显式处理Voronoi边界处骨骼预测的几何歧义性；（ii）设计双蒙皮特征场，将蒙皮权重与特定关节数量解耦，使固定架构网络能够预测任意复杂度的绑定系统。基于两阶段流匹配流程构建，AniGen首先生成稀疏结构框架，随后在结构化隐空间中生成稠密几何与关节系统。大量实验表明，AniGen在绑定有效性与动画质量上显著优于当前最先进的序列基线方法，并能有效泛化至野生动物、人形角色及机械装置等多样化类别的真实场景图像。项目主页：https://yihua7.github.io/AniGen-web/

title: Efficient Hierarchical Implicit Flow Q-learning for Offline Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) is a practical reinforcement learning paradigm that aims to learn goal-conditioned policies from reward-free offline data. Despite recent advances in hierarchical architectures such as HIQL, long-horizon control in offline GCRL remains challenging due to the limited expressiveness of Gaussian policies and the inability of high-level policies to generate effective subgoals. To address these limitations, we propose the goal-conditioned mean flow policy, which introduces an average velocity field into hierarchical policy modeling for offline GCRL. Specifically, the mean flow policy captures complex target distributions for both high-level and low-level policies through a learned average velocity field, enabling efficient action generation via one-step sampling. Furthermore, considering the insufficiency of goal representation, we introduce a LeJEPA loss that repels goal representation embeddings during training, thereby encouraging more discriminative representations and improving generalization. Experimental results show that our method achieves strong performance across both state-based and pixel-based tasks in the OGBench benchmark.
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical implicit flow Q-learning method for offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, introducing a mean flow policy for improved action generation and a LeJEPA loss for better goal representation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于离线目标条件强化学习的高效分层隐式流Q学习方法，通过引入平均流策略来改进动作生成，并使用LeJEPA损失来提升目标表示的判别性。
summary_zh: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）是一种实用的强化学习范式，旨在从无奖励的离线数据中学习目标条件策略。尽管HIQL等分层架构近期取得了进展，但由于高斯策略表达能力有限以及高层策略无法生成有效子目标，离线GCRL中的长时序控制仍面临挑战。为突破这些局限，我们提出目标条件均值流策略，通过引入平均速度场到离线GCRL的分层策略建模中。具体而言，均值流策略通过学习的平均速度场捕捉高层与低层策略的复杂目标分布，从而实现单步采样的高效动作生成。此外，针对目标表示能力不足的问题，我们引入LeJEPA损失函数，在训练过程中排斥目标表示嵌入向量，从而激励更具判别性的表示并提升泛化能力。实验结果表明，该方法在OGBench基准测试中，基于状态和基于像素的任务上均实现了优异性能。

title: Incremental Semantics-Aided Meshing from LiDAR-Inertial Odometry and RGB Direct Label Transfer
summary: Geometric high-fidelity mesh reconstruction from LiDAR-inertial scans remains challenging in large, complex indoor environments -- such as cultural buildings -- where point cloud sparsity, geometric drift, and fixed fusion parameters produce holes, over-smoothing, and spurious surfaces at structural boundaries. We propose a modular, incremental RGB+LiDAR pipeline that generates incremental semantics-aided high-quality meshes from indoor scans through scan frame-based direct label transfer. A vision foundation model labels each incoming RGB frame; labels are incrementally projected and fused onto a LiDAR-inertial odometry map; and an incremental semantics-aware Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) fusion step produces the final mesh via marching cubes. This frame-level fusion strategy preserves the geometric fidelity of LiDAR while leveraging rich visual semantics to resolve geometric ambiguities at reconstruction boundaries caused by LiDAR point-cloud sparsity and geometric drift. We demonstrate that semantic guidance improves geometric reconstruction quality; quantitative evaluation is therefore performed using geometric metrics on the Oxford Spires dataset, while results from the NTU VIRAL dataset are analyzed qualitatively. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art geometric baselines ImMesh and Voxblox, demonstrating the benefit of semantics-aided fusion for geometric mesh quality. The resulting semantically labelled meshes are of value when reconstructing Universal Scene Description (USD) assets, offering a path from indoor LiDAR scanning to XR and digital modeling.
tldr: Proposes a method to incrementally generate high-quality, semantically-labeled meshes for indoor environments by fusing LiDAR-inertial odometry with visual semantics from a vision foundation model, improving geometric reconstruction quality over pure geometric baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种增量方法，通过将LiDAR-惯性里程计与来自视觉基础模型的视觉语义信息融合，为室内环境生成高质量、带语义标签的网格，相比纯几何基线提高了重建质量。

title: PhysInOne: Visual Physics Learning and Reasoning in One Suite
summary: We present PhysInOne, a large-scale synthetic dataset addressing the critical scarcity of physically-grounded training data for AI systems. Unlike existing datasets limited to merely hundreds or thousands of examples, PhysInOne provides 2 million videos across 153,810 dynamic 3D scenes, covering 71 basic physical phenomena in mechanics, optics, fluid dynamics, and magnetism. Distinct from previous works, our scenes feature multiobject interactions against complex backgrounds, with comprehensive ground-truth annotations including 3D geometry, semantics, dynamic motion, physical properties, and text descriptions. We demonstrate PhysInOne's efficacy across four emerging applications: physics-aware video generation, long-/short-term future frame prediction, physical property estimation, and motion transfer. Experiments show that fine-tuning foundation models on PhysInOne significantly enhances physical plausibility, while also exposing critical gaps in modeling complex physical dynamics and estimating intrinsic properties. As the largest dataset of its kind, orders of magnitude beyond prior works, PhysInOne establishes a new benchmark for advancing physics-grounded world models in generation, simulation, and embodied AI.
tldr: A large-scale synthetic dataset (2M videos) for physics-grounded AI, covering diverse physical phenomena with comprehensive annotations, benchmarked for physics-aware generation, prediction, and simulation.
tldr_zh: 一个大规模合成数据集（200万个视频），涵盖多样化的物理现象，具有全面的标注，用于物理感知的生成、预测和仿真任务的基准测试。

title: "Take Me Home, Wi-Fi Drone": A Drone-based Wireless System for Wilderness Search and Rescue
summary: Wilderness Search and Rescue (WiSAR) represents a longstanding and critical societal challenge, demanding innovative and automatic technological solutions. In this paper, we introduce Wi2SAR, a novel autonomous drone-based wireless system for long-range, through-occlusion WiSAR operations, without relying on existing infrastructure. Our basic insight is to leverage the automatic reconnection behavior of modern Wi-Fi devices to known networks. By mimicking these networks via on-drone Wi-Fi, Wi2SAR uniquely facilitates the discovery and localization of victims through their accompanying mobile devices. Translating this simple idea into a practical system poses substantial technical challenges. Wi2SAR overcomes these challenges via three distinct innovations: (1) a rapid and energy-efficient device discovery mechanism to discover and identify the target victim, (2) a novel RSS-only, long-range direction finding approach using a 3D-printed Luneburg Lens, amplifying the directional signal strength differences and significantly extending the operational range, and (3) an adaptive drone navigation scheme that guides the drone toward the target efficiently. We implement an end-to-end prototype and evaluate Wi2SAR across various mobile devices and real-world wilderness scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate Wi2SAR's high performance, efficiency, and practicality, highlighting its potential to advance autonomous WiSAR solutions. Wi2SAR is open-sourced at https://aiot-lab.github.io/Wi2SAR to facilitate further research and real-world deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces Wi2SAR, an autonomous drone-based system that uses on-drone Wi-Fi to mimic known networks, enabling the discovery and localization of wilderness victims via their mobile devices' automatic reconnection behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Wi2SAR，一个自主无人机系统。该系统利用机载Wi-Fi模拟已知网络，通过受害者移动设备的自动重连行为，实现野外搜救中的目标发现与定位。

title: {\sf TriDeliver}: Cooperative Air-Ground Instant Delivery with UAVs, Couriers, and Crowdsourced Ground Vehicles
summary: Instant delivery, shipping items before critical deadlines, is essential in daily life. While multiple delivery agents, such as couriers, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), and crowdsourced agents, have been widely employed, each of them faces inherent limitations (e.g., low efficiency/labor shortages, flight control, and dynamic capabilities, respectively), preventing them from meeting the surging demands alone. This paper proposes {\sf TriDeliver}, the first hierarchical cooperative framework, integrating human couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced ground vehicles (GVs) for efficient instant delivery. To obtain the initial scheduling knowledge for GVs and UAVs as well as improve the cooperative delivery performance, we design a Transfer Learning (TL)-based algorithm to extract delivery knowledge from couriers' behavioral history and transfer their knowledge to UAVs and GVs with fine-tunings, which is then used to dispatch parcels for efficient delivery. Evaluated on one-month real-world trajectory and delivery datasets, it has been demonstrated that 1) by integrating couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced GVs, {\sf TriDeliver} reduces the delivery cost by $65.8\%$ versus state-of-the-art cooperative delivery by UAVs and couriers; 2) {\sf TriDeliver} achieves further improvements in terms of delivery time ($-17.7\%$), delivery cost ($-9.8\%$), and impacts on original tasks of crowdsourced GVs ($-43.6\%$), even with the representation of the transferred knowledge by simple neural networks, respectively.
tldr: TriDeliver is a cooperative air-ground instant delivery framework that integrates human couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced ground vehicles, using a transfer learning algorithm to extract knowledge from couriers' historical data to improve scheduling and delivery efficiency.
tldr_zh: TriDeliver是一个协作式空地即时配送框架，整合了人类快递员、无人机和众包地面车辆，通过迁移学习算法从快递员历史行为中提取知识，用于调度和提升配送效率。

title: Simulation of Adaptive Running with Flexible Sports Prosthesis using Reinforcement Learning of Hybrid-link System
summary: This study proposes a reinforcement learning-based adaptive running motion simulation for a unilateral transtibial amputee with the flexibility of a leaf-spring-type sports prosthesis using hybrid-link system. The design and selection of sports prostheses often rely on trial and error. A comprehensive whole-body dynamics analysis that considers the interaction between human motion and prosthetic deformation could provide valuable insights for user-specific design and selection. The hybrid-link system facilitates whole-body dynamics analysis by incorporating the Piece-wise Constant Strain model to represent the flexible deformation of the prosthesis. Based on this system, the simulation methodology generates whole-body dynamic motions of a unilateral transtibial amputee through a reinforcement learning-based approach, which combines imitation learning from motion capture data with accurate prosthetic dynamics computation. We simulated running motions under different virtual prosthetic stiffness conditions and analyzed the metabolic cost of transport obtained from the simulations, suggesting that variations in stiffness influence running performance. Our findings demonstrate the potential of this approach for simulation and analysis under virtual conditions that differ from real conditions.
tldr: This paper uses reinforcement learning and imitation learning to simulate adaptive running motions for an amputee with a flexible sports prosthesis, analyzing the impact of prosthetic stiffness on performance metrics like metabolic cost.
tldr_zh: 本研究使用强化学习和模仿学习，模拟了配备柔性运动假肢的截肢者的自适应跑步运动，分析了假肢刚度对跑步性能（如代谢消耗）的影响。

title: Accelerating Transformer-Based Monocular SLAM via Geometric Utility Scoring
summary: Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently advanced monocular SLAM by providing robust, calibration-free 3D priors. However, deploying these models on dense video streams introduces significant computational redundancy. Current GFM-based SLAM systems typically rely on post hoc keyframe selection. Because of this, they must perform expensive dense geometric decoding simply to determine whether a frame contains novel geometry, resulting in late rejection and wasted computation. To mitigate this inefficiency, we propose LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward frame-gating network. LeanGate predicts a geometric utility score to assess a frame's mapping value prior to the heavy GFM feature extraction and matching stages. As a predictive plug-and-play module, our approach bypasses over 90% of redundant frames. Evaluations on standard SLAM benchmarks demonstrate that LeanGate reduces tracking FLOPs by more than 85% and achieves a 5x end-to-end throughput speedup. Furthermore, it maintains the tracking and mapping accuracy of dense baselines.
tldr: Proposes a lightweight frame-gating network called LeanGate to predict geometric utility scores for monocular SLAM, significantly reducing computational redundancy by filtering frames before heavy feature extraction, achieving large speedups while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种名为 LeanGate 的轻量级帧门控网络，用于预测单目 SLAM 的几何效用分数，通过在繁重的特征提取前过滤帧来显著减少计算冗余，在保持精度的同时实现大幅加速。

title: SafeAdapt: Provably Safe Policy Updates in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safety guarantees are a prerequisite to the deployment of reinforcement learning (RL) agents in safety-critical tasks. Often, deployment environments exhibit non-stationary dynamics or are subject to changing performance goals, requiring updates to the learned policy. This leads to a fundamental challenge: how to update an RL policy while preserving its safety properties on previously encountered tasks? The majority of current approaches either do not provide formal guarantees or verify policy safety only a posteriori. We propose a novel a priori approach to safe policy updates in continual RL by introducing the Rashomon set: a region in policy parameter space certified to meet safety constraints within the demonstration data distribution. We then show that one can provide formal, provable guarantees for arbitrary RL algorithms used to update a policy by projecting their updates onto the Rashomon set. Empirically, we validate this approach across grid-world navigation environments (Frozen Lake and Poisoned Apple) where we guarantee an a priori provably deterministic safety on the source task during downstream adaptation. In contrast, we observe that regularisation-based baselines experience catastrophic forgetting of safety constraints while our approach enables strong adaptation with provable guarantees that safety is preserved.
tldr: This paper proposes SafeAdapt, a method for performing safe policy updates in continual reinforcement learning by projecting updates onto a provably safe region in policy parameter space, guaranteeing safety on previously encountered tasks during adaptation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SafeAdapt，一种在持续强化学习中进行安全策略更新的方法，通过将更新投影到策略参数空间中一个可证明安全的区域，保证在适应过程中对先前任务的安全性。

title: Compositional-Degradation UAV Image Restoration: Conditional Decoupled MoE Network and A Benchmark
summary: UAV images are critical for applications such as large-area mapping, infrastructure inspection, and emergency response. However, in real-world flight environments, a single image is often affected by multiple degradation factors, including rain, haze, and noise, undermining downstream task performance. Current unified restoration approaches typically rely on implicit degradation representations that entangle multiple factors into a single condition, causing mutual interference among heterogeneous corrections. To this end, we propose DAME-Net, a Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Network that decouples explicit degradation perception from degradation-conditioned reconstruction for compositional UAV image restoration. Specifically, we design a Factor-wise Degradation Perception module(FDPM) to provide explicit per-factor degradation cues for the restoration stage through multi-label prediction with label-similarity-guided soft alignment, replacing implicit entangled conditions with interpretable and generalizable degradation descriptions. Moreover, we develop a Conditioned Decoupled MoE module(CDMM) that leverages these cues for stage-wise conditioning, spatial-frequency hybrid processing, and mask-constrained decoupled expert routing, enabling selective factor-specific correction while suppressing irrelevant interference. In addition, we construct the Multi-Degradation UAV Restoration benchmark (MDUR), the first large-scale UAV benchmark for compositional UAV image restoration, with 43 degradation configurations from single degradations to four-factor composites and standardized seen/unseen splits.Extensive experiments on MDUR demonstrate consistent improvements over representative unified restoration methods, with greater gains on unseen and higher-order composite degradations. Downstream experiments further validate benefits for UAV object detection.
tldr: This paper proposes DAME-Net, a degradation-aware mixture-of-experts network for restoring UAV images affected by multiple factors like rain and haze, and introduces a new benchmark dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DAME-Net，一种用于修复受雨、雾等多因素影响的无人机图像的退化感知专家混合网络，并引入了一个新的基准数据集。

title: MAG-3D: Multi-Agent Grounded Reasoning for 3D Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet grounded reasoning in 3D scenes remains underexplored. Effective 3D reasoning hinges on accurate grounding: to answer open-ended queries, a model must first identify query-relevant objects and regions in a complex scene, and then reason about their spatial and geometric relationships. Recent approaches have demonstrated strong potential for grounded 3D reasoning. However, they often rely on in-domain tuning or hand-crafted reasoning pipelines, which limit their flexibility and zero-shot generalization to novel environments.
